reviews.text: Like the product, but find need to be regular using it to maintain softness
reviews.zh: 我幾鍾意呢款產品，但係發覺要恆常使用先可以維持到柔順度。

reviews.text: Delicious scent. Doesn’t weigh my fine hair down. A little goes a long way, so I think this will last a long time!
reviews.zh: 味道好好聞。唔會壓扁我嘅幼細髮質。只需要少少份量就夠，所以我諗會用好耐！

reviews.text: My 2nd buy for this hair treatment, on certain days when the weather is more humid this is good to tame fizziness
reviews.zh: 呢款護髮素係我第二次買，喺天氣比較潮濕嘅日子，佢好有助抑制毛躁。

reviews.text: Great hair mask-nice smell, texture and smooth hair. Don't know about the hair full out...but it's nice . Bogth it fot 3 time.
reviews.zh: 好好嘅護髮膜，味道、質地都好好，頭髮順滑。唔知對脫髮有冇幫助……不過都幾好。我買過咗三次。

reviews.text: Been hearing about this brand and wanted to try this treatment so glad OY carries this. First usage went well, smoother hair.
reviews.zh: 一直聽人講呢個品牌，想試吓呢款護理，好開心 OY 有賣呢款。第一次用好順利，頭髮更加順滑。

reviews.text: This is huge. Tried the mini that came with the shampoo set. This is large will last a while. Makes my hair feel great and I can feel with every use my hair is getting better!!
reviews.zh: 真係好大支！我試過洗頭水套裝入面附送嘅細裝。呢支容量好大，可以用好耐。令我頭髮感覺好好，而且每次用都感覺到頭髮越嚟越好！！

reviews.text: It’s fine but there are better, does it’s job but nothing out of this world, shampoo is much better
reviews.zh: 都可以，但係仲有更好嘅，都做到嘢，但係冇咩特別，洗頭水會好好多。

reviews.text: Large volume of the mask, very tasty smell, you can feel the pleasant oils in the composition. If you keep it on your head longer than 5 minutes - I think the result will be even better. My best recommendation!
reviews.zh: 護髮膜容量好大，味道好香，可以感受到配方入面令人舒服嘅油分。如果你敷喺頭上多過5分鐘，我諗效果會更好。我最大力推薦！

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
